title: OCI Audit Log Baseline Ingestion

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `oci:audit` events matching `*` into `index=oci`. Confirm UC-4.7.1 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `oci:audit` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=oci` sourcetype=`oci:audit` collected via Splunk Add-on for OCI (Splunkbase 5680); validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=oci sourcetype="oci:audit"
| table _time eventName identity.principalName resourceId
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.7.1_oci_audit_log_baseline_i_1"
| sort -_time
description: Verifies oci audit log baseline ingestion data flows into Splunk continuously. This UC monitors `oci:audit` for oci audit log baseline ingestion and surfaces events for SOC triage, change review, and compliance evidence.
value: OCI Audit Log Baseline Ingestion is the prerequisite feed for all 4.7 detections.
implementation: Enable oci:audit ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=oci.
visualization: Ingestion health single value and lag chart.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=oci`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for OCI (Splunkbase 5680) with the modular input for `oci:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): none.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `eventName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable oci:audit ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=oci.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=oci sourcetype="oci:audit"
| table _time eventName identity.principalName resourceId
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.7.1_oci_audit_log_baseline_i_1"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `oci:audit` in `index=oci` to detect oci audit log baseline ingestion. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the OCI Console Audit page for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `eventName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_7_1_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Ingestion health single value and lag chart..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for OCI (Splunkbase 5680) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of oci audit log baseline ingestion so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
